sections.title: Charanam 1
lyrics: pancha shara janaka prapanchamuna gala sukhamu manchu valEnanuchu madhinenchiti kAni
panchukoni dhanamulArjinchukoni sariyevvaranchu mari gathiyu lEdhanchu palkithinA
Charanam 2 - dhinamu nithyOthsavamunakAsa jendhiti nA manasuna illu okaTiyaniyuNTi kAni
anu dhinamunorula mElunu jUci tALa lEkanu reNDu sEya valenanuchu palkithinA
Charanam 3 - prANamE pAThiyani mAnamE mElaNTi kAni shrI rAma paramAnanda jaladhi
shrI nAtha kulamulO lEni dArini paTTi jEneDudaramu nimpanorula pogaDitinA
Charanam 4 - AjAnu bAhu yuga shrI jAnakI pathi payOj(A)ksha shrI thyAgarAja nutha charaNa
I jagathilO ninnu poojinchuvArinavyAjamuna brOchE surAja nIvADaina
